title: Anti-Pattern: model wording rejected twice, then accepted
shows: Heat task never won. Code mines two patterns (a repeated `wait` and a repeated `examine`). The model's wording for the first ("When waiting for an object to cool, do not use the command wait") is rejected twice because it mentions "cool", a word the measured pattern does not contain. The `examine` pattern is accepted as rule_16 and stays visible.
why_interesting: The code check that the model may only word the measured pattern. Also: a hidden Special Phenomenon is stored from the same lost game.
